listing.sub: Record, polish and play every player's walk-up
listing.desc: Record each player's name and number on your phone, polish it with an equalizer, compressor and room reverb, and pick the song the player chose. Balance the voice against the music with one slider, choose when the voice starts, and play the whole walk-up with one big button on game day. Everything stays on your phone, works offline, and backs up to a single file. Ask a parent for a song by text or email: they pick it on their phone and send it back, and it lands on the right player.
feats: Record and polish
Record the announcement, trim the silence, then shape it with a five-band equalizer, a compressor and a room reverb.
Mix voice and music
Pick Even, Louder voice or Louder music with one slider, nudge when the voice starts a tenth of a second at a time, and let the music soften under the voice.
Play it at the plate
One big Play button runs the batting order, shows who is on deck, and fades out smoothly on Stop.
Ask a parent for the song
Send a link by text or email. The parent picks the song on their phone and sends it back, and Walk-Up matches it to the player. No account, no server.

news.t: New: a simpler mixer that fits a phone with no scrolling. One relative-volume slider, a nudge for when the voice starts, and the fine controls on short tabs.
